title: Transformation of Vibrio natriegens
author: Carlos Helbig
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ptsdnne
materials: Defrost your competent cells on ice
Plate the pellet on warm agar plates (30°C)

steps.title: Add DNA template
steps.instruction: Add the DNA template to the cells and mix gently.

steps.title: Perform heat shock
steps.instruction: Heatshock the cells at 42°C for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells on ice for 90 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate at 30°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 30°C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 3000g for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells on ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add recovery medium
steps.instruction: Add 1ml of BHI + V 2 -Salts (pre-heated to 30°C) to the cells.
